title: Capacity Tuning Assistant: SLA-aware Fleet Snapshot and Actionables
creator: Ana Martinez
description:
Goal:
Build a "Capacity Tuning Assistant" that produces an SLA-aware snapshot of a customer's dedicated fleet and returns prioritized, low-risk actionables to improve cost/performance. The assistant should combine recent utilization, latency headroom, autoscale policy effectiveness, and model profile info to surface: incremental scale-down candidates, autoscale policy parameter tweaks, burst-capacity reassignments, and targeted caching/warming recommendations.

Why this is different:
Existing tooling mostly focuses on long-running 'rightsizing' recommendations or bulk reallocation heuristics. The Assistant emphasizes short, verifiable actions (safe first) coupled with an estimated SLO risk and dollar-savings model and a simulation mode that predicts outcomes under a historical traffic replay. This will let SEs and customers adopt smaller incremental changes with confidence.

Inputs: 
- last 14 days of token throughput per pool and per-tenant
- per-tenant p95/p99 latency and error rates
- autoscaler logs (scale events, trigger reasons, cool-downs)
- model variant and typical sequence length distribution
- current reserved commit level and burst capacity settings

Outputs: 
- Fleet snapshot: utilization heatmap (per-node, per-pool), tail latency offsets, and autoscale hit/miss ratio
- Actionables: ranked list with reason, estimated monthly $ delta, estimated SLO risk (none/low/medium/high), and minimum safe guard (e.g., enable canary for 48h)
- Simulation result: replayed-window summary showing expected latency and spend after applying actionables
- API: /v1/dedicated/assistant/snapshot and /v1/dedicated/assistant/simulate (read-only for now)

Acceptance criteria:
- Snapshot generation completes < 60s for fleets up to 2k GPUs (prototype)
- Actionables include at least three low-risk proposals per pool when utilization < 40% for 72+ hours
- Simulation accuracy: predicted spend within 10% of observed after controlled pilot test
- Console UI surface: one-click export to 'change plan' and an option to open a canary rollout with our rollout service

Technical approach (high level):
1) Aggregation pipeline: new nightly job + 1h near-realtime aggregator to compute sliding window metrics and autoscaler event enrichment.
2) Risk model: rules + lightweight ML classifier trained on past rollbacks/incidents (features: p95 delta, scale frequency, queue length). Initially rules-only, classifier added after 2 months of pilots.
3) Savings estimator: cost-per-token model + amortized GPU-hour savings for scale-downs + projected cost of increased tail latency (penalty factor configurable by PM).
4) Simulation engine: traffic replayer that runs at the requested scale in an isolated sandbox (no tenant traffic impact) using sampled requests and current autoscale policies.

Data/Privacy considerations:
- Use downsampled traces and aggregate metrics for customer exports by default; full traces only with explicit consent.
- Ensure KMS access for simulation artifacts stored in S3-compatible store with expiry.

Rollout plan:
- Week 0–2: implement snapshot API + console surface for internal QA on non-prod fleets.
- Week 3–6: enable simulation and run against 3 internal customer-like fleets; tune risk rules.
- Week 7–10: soft-launch to beta customers with opt-in, monitor rollbacks and simulator accuracy.

Monitoring and success metrics:
- Adoption: % of Dedicated customers who run Assistant at least once in first 30 days (target 20%)
- Safety: <5% of low-risk actionables that trigger rollback/incidents during pilot
- Economics: average per-pool monthly cost reduction for adopters > 6% within first 30 days
- Performance: snapshot generation latency P95 < 60s

Open questions / trade-offs:
- Conservative defaults vs aggressive savings: default to conservative (low-risk) for GA.
- Classifier training data scarcity: start rules-only and seed classifier with simulated incidents.
- How much of the assistant is exposed to customers vs only available to SEs? Start SE-only, beta customers after Week 10.

Links and artifacts:
- Design mockups: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1X-capacity-assistant-mocks (internal)
- Prototype PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1178
- Observability dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/dedicated/assistant/dashboard (internal)
